storage_creation.qualification: Content-producer identity and exact returned payload are direct records; storage writer and formatted storage bytes are separately identified.

evidence_loci.proves: same payload bound to completed task turn

FTC01_recovery.caveat: RUN-058D-1 itself still omits producer identity; closure requires embedding this exact external provenance in the reseal.

FTC10.change: Add only stable claim records and an explicit atom-to-locus map; retain all claim meaning, classifications, projects, facets and loci.
FTC10.claim_id_rule: CLM-<existing-owner-record-id>-<zero-padded-atom-ordinal>; owner is the existing PRJ or FAC record and IDs are immutable after seal.
mapping_rules: split every retained assertion into atomic claims
map every claim to one or more existing stable locus IDs
permit multiple loci per atom but no prose-only or line-range-only surrogate
require unique claim IDs, deterministic owner/ordinal ordering and zero unmapped atoms
FTC10.counts: Record the mechanically derived claim total and mapped total; do not invent a total from the two allowed inputs.

link_counts.resealed_post_correction: 12/12 only after mechanical verification of the corrected link
link_counts.rule: Do not overwrite the historical 11/12 finding with an unexplained 12/12 assertion.

serialization.storage_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, no BOM, exactly one terminal LF; stored key order/indentation are formatting and are not claimed to be canonical.
serialization.file_sha256: Hash exact stored bytes, including the terminal LF.
serialization.record_hash_preimage: RFC8785/JCS UTF-8 bytes of the individual record, recursive canonical object-key ordering, declared array order preserved, no BOM, indentation or framing terminal LF.
serialization.distinction: Storage SHA-256 and record/facet SHA-256 use different explicitly named byte domains.

reseal: Keep claim maps additive and outside unchanged substantive facet bodies where possible.
Recompute every changed claim, facet, dedupe and packet hash deterministically.
Record reviewed 11/12 and verified corrected 12/12 as separate states.
Require a different independent exact-hash review before formal acceptance or generator readiness.
